leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a basic external store using a simple JavaScript object
Configure a React component to subscribe to external store changes
Initialize useSyncExternalStore with subscription and getSnapshot functions
Render component state that automatically updates when the external store changes
Manipulate external store data and observe synchronized component updates
Integrate useSyncExternalStore with custom event listeners for store changes
Construct a complete example with external store, subscription, and React component synchronization
